## Switch.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `checked` :: Whether the switch is on. Two-way bindable.
- `size` :: The track and text scale.
- `textSize` :: The text scale of the label, independent of the control. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `label` :: The visible label.
- `description` :: Secondary text under the label, in a quieter ink.
- `align` :: Which side of the switch the label sits on.
- `invalid` :: Marks the switch as failing validation: a danger border and `aria-invalid`.
- `name` :: The field name submitted with a form.
- `value` :: The value submitted with a form when on.
- `onCheckedChange` :: Called after the user flips the switch, with the new state.
- `children` :: Rich label content, used in place of `label`.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the label.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of the pill that fills when the switch is on. @default 'round'
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the description under the label. @default 'text-sm'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the description under the label. @default 'text-secondary'
- `gap` :: The space between the switch and its label. @default 'gap-md'
